subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should OpenClaw accept agents.defaults.compaction.turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs as the opt-in product contract for bounded deferred turn-maintenance recovery, including the late-side-effect fence semantics?
rationale: The code path looks coherent, but adding a config/default surface and changing enabled session-state recovery policy is a maintainer product and compatibility decision, not a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Accept the opt-in timeout contract
options.body: Land this PR after exact-head validation and treat the disabled-by-default config key plus fence behavior as the canonical recovery path for #96703.

options.title: Revise the timeout policy before merge
options.body: Ask for a maintainer-owned change to the config name, default, units, or fence semantics before landing the same underlying repair.

options.title: Pause for a different recovery design
options.body: Keep #97175 open but do not land until maintainers choose a broader queued-message recovery or burst-coalescing design.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in timeout contract
recommendation.body: Land this PR after exact-head validation and treat the disabled-by-default config key plus fence behavior as the canonical recovery path for #96703.
